Q072-02.notes: Squaring twice gives x-1=2sqrt(x-1) -> x=1 or 5; both check (sqrt4-0=2, sqrt16-sqrt4=2). A omits x=1 (students dividing by sqrt(x-1) or assuming extraneous); B omits 5; D: x=2 gives sqrt7-1 != 2.

Q072-04.notes: r(x)<0 for all x; (x-a)(x-b)<0 on (a,b) so p>0 there. B sign reversed; C: for x>b product (+)(-)<0; D: r has no real zeros, so only 2 x-intercepts.

Q072-05.notes: Max of f at x=2 -> f(x-3) max at x=5; -2*5+1=-9, reflection makes it a minimum. A calls it a max; B wrong shift direction (x=-1); C wrong value (-12).

Q072-06.notes: Roots r,4r: 4r^2=36 -> r=+/-3; k=-(5r)=-/+15; positive value 15 (roots -3,-12).

Q072-07.notes: ((x+1)^2-x^2)/(x(x+1))=(2x+1)/(x^2+x). A: invalid cancellation; B: forgot 2x term; D: sign reversed (subtraction order).

Q072-09.notes: y=H-ax^2 with y(20)=0, y(15)=7: 400a-225a=7 -> a=0.04, H=16. Assumes symmetric parabola with vertex at top, standard for an arch.

Q072-10.notes: Cross-multiply: (x-1)^2=(x+1)^2 -> x=0; check -1/1=1/(-1). A wrong (0 works); C: those are excluded values; D: equation is not an identity (e.g., x=2 gives 1/3 vs 3).

Q072-11.notes: (3-k)x=-(k+6). k=3: 0=-9, no solution. k=0: LHS never 0 (algebraic x=-2 is extraneous). k=-6: x=0 works (-3=-3), so D wrong; A and C each miss one case.

Q072-12.notes: 6/(3-x)=-6/(x-3); (2x-6)/(x-3)=2. A ignores sign flip; B sign error; C multiplies by (x+3) incorrectly treating 3-x as x+3.
